animationScope: 48 painted poses per creature, E/SE/S/SW/W/NW/N/NE x idle/run-a/run-b/attack/hurt/death. Two movement drawings; six banks do not claim six full multiframe clips.
mechanicalPacking: Complete unedited source rectangle crops with margin, uniformly resized and registered into 128x192 cells. Alpha support measured only, never threshold-erased or painted.
qa: All 192 native registered poses viewed on beige and dark contacts. Distinct opposite movement drawings, naturally collapsed death drawings. No visible mattes, clipping or adjacent-cell fragments.
